how_to_use: Give this file to Claude Code at the root of the fmap repo with the agent_prompt below. It describes the whole project, the decisions already made, every pipeline (department), how each is verified, and what to build next.
agent_prompt: You are the single orchestrating agent for Find Me A Property (fmap). Read docs/project.spec.json, docs/architecture.md and .claude/skills/fmap-pipeline/SKILL.md first. Work one pipeline at a time, in build_order. For each pipeline: (1) ask the user the open questions listed for it and record their answers in this spec under decisions; (2) state the plan in a few lines; (3) build or change only what that pipeline needs; (4) verify it: run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` and `python3 toolkit/orchestrator/orchestrator.py run` (add --fetch-reels or --render on the laptop when the pipeline needs them), then read outputs/report/status.md; (5) report what passed, what is blocked and why. Never weaken a verification rule or a compliance pattern to make a run pass. Never post, email, scrape media, or contact anyone. Never commit private inputs, outputs, or config.local.json: the repo is public.

project.name: Find Me A Property (fmap)
what_we_sell: Layer 3: property shortlist, handed to a MahaRERA-registered agent

segments.investor: buying to rent or resell (first focus for reels)
segments.end_user: buying a home to live in
segments.legacy: sea-facing home in a small project

project.laptop_engine: research and content engine (backend/main.py, social-media-manager/v11_carousel_generator.py) at engine.root in toolkit/config.local.json

decisions.answer: User gives reel links; captions fetched on the laptop with --fetch-reels (Instagram is blocked from the cloud session). Captions can also be pasted into reels.csv.
Combine: Remotion templates for data reels (main), MoneyPrinterTurbo for a stock-footage version, ffmpeg for audio and checks, OpenMontage as an optional third version via a brief.

User wanted listing and portal media. Decision: facts from listings and portals are used with source credit; their photos and videos are not scraped or reused (copyright and portal terms). Visuals are data cards, free licensed stock (Pexels via MoneyPrinterTurbo), own footage later, and listing media only with written permission logged in listings.csv.
AI voice now (edge-tts, en-IN-NeerjaNeural), the user's own voice later via custom audio.
Laptop, where private inputs live. CI renders one silent test reel to prove the pipeline works.
Analyse why they work and rebuild the pattern in our own words. Never copy captions, footage, or audio.

constraints: No project shown, matched, posted, or rendered without a real MahaRERA ID.
Prices only when verified, always with their date.
No promised returns, 'best', 'sold out', 'risk-free', or fake urgency (toolkit/departments/compliance.py).
Every caption and reel carries: 'Research, not advice. Verify on MahaRERA before you pay.'
Every post needs the MahaRERA QR code and the agent's MahaRERA registration before posting.
Lead data never enters the repo; only counts are reported. DPDP Act 2023: consent, minimal data, deletion on request.
Property sales only through a MahaRERA-registered agent; no deposits or commissions taken by fmap.
Use calesthio/OpenMontage only. The lookalike Open-Montage-app/OpenMontage pushes an installer download and is not trusted.

commands.remotion_studio: cd video && npm ci && npm run studio

pipelines.name: engine
pipelines.purpose: Run the laptop research engine and carousel generator; collect the newest *_projects.json.
pipelines.status: built; blocked until engine.root is set on the laptop
open_questions: Has the engine's projects.json format changed since the 2 Aug Drive copy?

pipelines.name: intake
pipelines.purpose: Map engine projects to candidate register rows and diff them against data/properties.csv.
verify: every candidate has a project name
pipelines.human_gate: A person reviews diff.md and edits data/properties.csv by hand.
pipelines.status: built; blocked until research input exists
open_questions: Which file is the confirmed research document?

pipelines.name: register
pipelines.purpose: Check the curated project register every other pipeline uses.
pipelines.human_gate: Set research_confirmed=true once the register matches the research document.

pipelines.name: listings
pipelines.purpose: Screen properties found on the internet down to what may be showcased.
verify: RERA ID agrees with the register
pipelines.human_gate: Ask the lister for written permission before using any of their media.
open_questions: Which portals and listings do you want tracked first?

pipelines.name: references
pipelines.purpose: Analyse reference reels: caption hook, length, structure, call to action, hashtags, emoji, engagement; explain why each works; pick a pattern and template per segment.
inputs: data/inputs/reels.csv (url, account, caption, format, length_sec, notes)
verify: at least one valid Instagram reel URL
playbook contains no copied caption text
pipelines.human_gate: Add notes on visuals (cuts, text placement, music) that a caption cannot show.
open_questions: Which accounts do you admire most, and why?

pipelines.name: matching
pipelines.purpose: Shortlist projects per segment and budget using verified fields only.
verify: matched projects have a real MahaRERA ID and verified price
pipelines.human_gate: Re-check matched projects on MahaRERA before sending to a buyer.

pipelines.name: content
pipelines.purpose: Post kits (reel script, carousel, caption) for verified projects and screened listings.
verify: MahaRERA ID, disclaimer, and QR placeholder in every kit

pipelines.name: storyboard
pipelines.purpose: Turn verified projects plus the reel playbook into scene-by-scene reel plans, original captions, a MoneyPrinterTurbo request, and an OpenMontage brief.

templates.price_check: price hook → MahaRERA ID → status and developer → still to check → CTA
templates.three_checks: 3-checks hook → ID → status → open items → CTA
templates.myth_vs_fact: myth → registered-sales fact → ID → still to check → CTA

verify: scene durations add up to the plan
caption has MahaRERA ID and disclaimer
no banned claims in text, voice, or caption
pipelines.status: running (2 investor plans from verified projects)
open_questions: Any hook lines you want to test?

pipelines.name: video
pipelines.purpose: Render plans to MP4: edge-tts voice per scene, scenes stretched to fit speech, ffmpeg join and loudness normalisation (-14 LUFS), Remotion render; optional MoneyPrinterTurbo stock version.
inputs: video/ (Remotion project; cd video && npm ci)
verify: duration within 0.5s of the timed plan
pipelines.human_gate: Watch every render; check facts on MahaRERA; add QR code and agent number; post by hand.
pipelines.status: running; verified here with a silent voice (edge-tts is blocked from the cloud session, works on the laptop)

pipelines.name: web
pipelines.purpose: Static site: home, three segment funnels (checklist → guide → shortlist), checklist, privacy.
pipelines.status: running; deploys from main via GitHub Pages once main exists

pipelines.name: compliance
pipelines.purpose: Scan site, products, and post kits for banned claims.

pipelines.name: leads
pipelines.purpose: Counts from a local Google Sheet export; never names, emails, or phones.

pipelines.name: launch
pipelines.purpose: Final gate listing every missing launch setting.
verify: form links, agent MahaRERA number, contact email, ebook store links, research_confirmed

patterns.price_reveal: hook opens on a price → fits investor, end_user → template price_check
patterns.list: 3+ list lines → fits all → template three_checks
patterns.question_hook: hook is a question → fits end_user, legacy → template three_checks
patterns.myth_vs_fact: myth/fact framing → fits investor, legacy → template myth_vs_fact
patterns.pov: POV opener → fits end_user → template three_checks
patterns.statement: plain statement → fits all → template price_check

reuse_rules: Copy the shape, not the words.
Caption length, hashtag count and CTA type follow the reference median.
All facts come from the verified register, never from the reference reel.

remotion.notes: Renders any plan JSON; keeps text out of Instagram's top 260px and bottom 460px.

edge_tts.notes: Free Microsoft neural voices; needs internet on the laptop.

api.create: POST /api/v1/videos (VideoParams: video_subject, video_script, video_terms, video_aspect '9:16', video_source 'pexels', voice_name, subtitle_enabled)
api.poll: GET /api/v1/tasks/{task_id} → data.state 1 complete, -1 failed, 4 processing; data.videos list
api.download: GET /tasks/<file> (x-api-key header when app.api_key is set)

moneyprinterturbo.config: video.moneyprinterturbo_url and video.moneyprinterturbo_api_key in toolkit/config.local.json; needs a Pexels API key in its own config.toml

openmontage.license: AGPLv3: used as a separate tool, never copied into this repo
openmontage.usage: Clone it, run `make setup`, open it in Claude Code, and paste outputs/storyboard/openmontage/<id>.md as the prompt.
